remaining: Sentinel discovery/re-resolution, stale-role retry/endpoint replacement and Cluster routing remain required next stages.
Replica identity is point-in-time and does not establish freshness. A role can change after Ready; each new connection must rediscover/verify as appropriate.

Timing is unpinned loopback component evidence. Unqualified noisy series are preserved and excluded from regression conclusions. Cold setup samples include worker/network/peer parsing; physical cleanup lies outside timing and mechanical setup-release tails can overlap the sampled interval.
Allocation measurements include loopback fixture work and release tails, not just the library; no isolated library-setup allocation or production throughput/P99 claim is made.
Native Linux pinned/CPU/RSS/upstream/fixed-arrival/mixed workloads and >=72h acceptance remain open for the full four-library objective.

The first TLS single wrapper selected a test-only module without a feature. Corrected only wrapper selection; completed v1 production/root/bare and layout/size evidence remains byte-identical. Failed inputs/logs are preserved.
Zero-valued heap columns in uninstrumented role-setup are placeholders, explicitly marked unmeasured; only role-setup-heap measures allocations.
